title: triticum syriacum
intro: Triticum syriacum, commonly known as Syrian wheat or Syrian emmer, is an ancient, hulled wheat species native to the Near East. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including its potential to regulate blood sugar levels and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Triticum syriacum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Triticum syriacum include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other compounds that may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
